_README: Config for convert_algs.py. Two separate jobs, both of which must be right
before converted data is worth anything:
1. 'fields' says where the numbers live in the API response. Every value
below is a GUESS: apexlegendsstatus.com does not publish a response
schema for ring data. Run 'python convert_algs.py --inspect dump.json'
on a real response and correct these paths before converting anything.
2. 'maps' says how to turn the source's world coordinates into fractions of
YOUR cropped map image. This cannot be guessed at all: it depends on the
crop you made on the /setup page. Until a map is calibrated, the
converter refuses to emit games for it, which is deliberate - silently
misaligned data is worse than no data, because the predictor will still

_map_aliases_note: Source map name -> slug. Only display names are listed, because they are
the only ones worth guessing at. If the API reports internal names like
mp_rr_something instead, the converter prints the ones it did not
recognise and skips those games; add the real names here then. Do not
guess: sending one map's games to another map's slug mixes two maps'
data, and nothing downstream would flag it.
